title: Lease checks before signing
text: Before signing a lease in Portugal, renters should verify the monthly rent, whether utilities are included, the deposit amount, contract length, renewal terms, and who is responsible for internet, water, and electricity. Users should also confirm whether the offer is a short-term furnished rental or a longer local lease.

title: Residence and immigration basics
text: Residence and immigration requirements vary by nationality and purpose of stay. Depending on the route, users may need proof of accommodation, proof of income, and other supporting documents. Official Portuguese immigration resources should be checked regularly because processes and instructions can change.

title: Portugal housing planning estimates
text: Housing and living costs are often higher in Lisbon than in smaller cities such as Coimbra. Users should compare rent, transport, internet, and move-in costs rather than relying only on headline monthly rent. Short-term expat-facing listings may be much more expensive than standard local leases.
